Merge condition, not a blocker: the definition of done is only partly met before root acts. The DoD asks that clean and demo refuse with a typed reason when the interval is absent or outside the source. In the lane tree, the current media.py rejects fuller.json with an untyped 'profile contains unsupported fields', and its CLI error JSON has no 'reason' key. Typed refusals exist only once root applies RQ-M1, so the fuller profile is unusable (it fails closed) until then.

RQ-M1 design widening for root to decide. check_capture_request and bind_capture accept --capture-interval for ANY profile with denoise:true, for example conservative3 or mild6, not only templates that set noise_capture_required. The CLI binding surface is therefore broader than the fuller template.

Consequences root should weigh. RQ-C1: any edit to media.py changes validator_sha256, so existing capture receipts can no longer be re-applied through apply_capture_profile. RQ-M2: once the default is flipped, a plain 'clean INPUT' or 'demo INPUT' with no interval refuses with capture_interval_required. RQ-M1b: it breaks the test_sprint1_audit tools.json pin c13b2f89...
